proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal - Federal Securities Laws Mandatory Arbitration Bylaw
proposals.proponent: Hal Scott/The Doris Behr 2012 Irrevocable Trust, Harvard Law School
proposals.topic_summary: Adopt a mandatory arbitration bylaw for federal securities law claims, barring class actions, with a five-year sunset provision.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST the adoption of this proposal

proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal - Civil Rights, Equity, Diversity & Inclusion Audit Proposal
proposals.proponent: National Center for Public Policy Research (NCPPR)
proposals.topic_summary: Commission a racial equity audit of the company's impacts on civil rights, equity, diversity and inclusion, and publicly disclose a report.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST the adoption of this proposal for the following reasons

proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal – Third Party Racial Justice Audit
proposals.proponent: Mercy Investment Services (Sisters of Mercy of the Americas)
proposals.topic_summary: Oversee a third-party racial justice audit assessing racial impacts of policies, practices and products, with a published report.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST the adoption of this proposal for the following reasons

proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal – Report on Government Financial Support and Access to COVID-19 Vaccines and Therapeutics
proposals.topic_summary: Report on whether government financial support for COVID-19 products is considered in conduct affecting access, such as pricing.
proposals.evidence: It is, therefore, recommended that shareholders vote AGAINST this proposal.

proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal – Report on Public Health Costs of Protecting Vaccine Technology
proposals.topic_summary: Commission a report on public health costs of limited sharing of COVID-19 vaccine technology and effects on shareholder market returns.
proposals.evidence: It is, therefore, recommended that shareholders vote AGAINST this proposal

proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal – Discontinue Global Sales of Baby Powder Containing Talc
proposals.topic_summary: Recommend that the company discontinue global sales of its talc-based Baby Powder.
proposals.evidence: It is, therefore, recommended that shareholders vote AGAINST this proposal.

proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal – Request for Charitable Donations Disclosure
proposals.topic_summary: Publish semi-annual report itemizing charitable donations above $999 by recipient, with giving policies and decision personnel.
proposals.evidence: It is, therefore, recommended that shareholders vote AGAINST this proposal.

proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal - Third Party Review and Report on Lobbying Activities Alignment with Position on Universal Health Coverage
proposals.topic_summary: Commission third-party review of whether lobbying aligns with the company's Universal Health Coverage position and report on risk mitigation.
proposals.evidence: It is, therefore, recommended that shareholders vote AGAINST this proposal.

proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal – Adopt Policy to Include Legal and Compliance Costs in Incentive Compensation Metrics
proposals.proponent: State of Vermont - Vermont Pension Investment Commission
proposals.topic_summary: Adopt policy barring exclusion of legal or compliance costs from financial metrics used in senior executive incentive awards.
proposals.evidence: It is, therefore, recommended that shareholders vote AGAINST this proposal.

proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal – CEO Compensation to Weigh Workforce Pay and Ownership
proposals.proponent: Myra K. Young, c/o John Chevedden
proposals.topic_summary: Have the Compensation Committee consider pay grades and stock ownership incentives of all U.S. employees when setting CEO pay targets.
proposals.evidence: It is, therefore, recommended that shareholders vote AGAINST this proposal.
